profile_text.body:
Humane Intelligence is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit founded in 2022 and headquartered in Katy, Texas, United States. On its own site it describes itself as dedicated to breaking down barriers to AI deployment for social good, and says it collaboratively designs and runs evaluations intended to make AI systems more accountable, responsible, and fair.

The organization describes three main offerings. AI red teaming, which it characterizes as a semi-structured testing approach for finding vulnerabilities and limitations in models and systems, is offered as a paid service using its own software, which it says will be released under an open source license in 2026. AI Contextual Evaluations are described as rigorous, mixed-method, bespoke evaluations of a model or system's performance in a specified problem space, also a paid service, with the company saying it is rapidly developing knowledge graph and ontological AI problem space mapping in 2026. Bias bounties, described as collaboratively designed challenge sets bringing together researchers, impacted communities, and domain experts, ran self-hosted until the final one closed in November 2025, and the company says it is working to move the program onto Zindi, a global data science challenge platform. It invites contact at info@humane-intelligence.org.

No litigation is recorded against the organization, and no products or MCP servers are recorded for it.
